codeReview.summary: The fragment-redaction update is correct, but the remote git cache still invokes `git fetch`/`git clone` with the raw credential-bearing source URL, so the blocking leak window remains.

issues.description: `ensureRemoteCache()` still passes `sourceUrl` directly to both `git fetch` and `git clone` instead of a network-safe redacted URL. That means credentialed URLs still cross the subprocess boundary, so the fix does not satisfy the requirement that raw credentials never be handed to git operations even briefly.

The new regression only inspects `.git/config` and `.git/logs` after the fact; it does not assert that the `git` argv itself was redacted. As written, this test would still miss the remaining raw-URL clone/fetch bug.

summary: Reviewed the fix and the original failure. Fragment redaction and at-rest scans improved, but the implementation still hands the raw credentialed URL to git, so the fix does not fully close the leak window.
